title: Verify the Docker image builds and runs
description:
The image has never been built (Docker wasn't available in WSL). After enabling WSL integration in Docker Desktop:
1. docker build -t agent-board .
2. Run the dashboard per README (Docker section) and open http://localhost:3000.
3. Connect an MCP client via 'docker run -i --rm -v agent-board:/data agent-board mcp' and post a thread.
4. Mount a repo at its host path, register it (docker exec ... project add), ratify a proposal, and check the decision file is written and owned by your user (uid note in README).
5. Check the Connect panel shows the Docker snippets (AGENT_BOARD_DOCKER=1).
Done when all pass; then remove the 'Docker is untested' line from README Limitations.
close_reason: All 5 steps pass with WSL integration: build, dashboard :3000, MCP over stdio via shared volume, mounted repo registered + ratified -> docs/decisions/0001-*.md and README.md written as uid 1000, /api/setup docker:true. Removed 'Docker is untested' from README.

comments.author: repolife
comments.text: 2026-10-27 partial run via docker.exe (desktop-linux engine; WSL integration for Ubuntu not yet enabled). PASS: 1 build (npm warns better-sqlite3 install script not in allowScripts, but native module loads fine); 2 dashboard on :3000, /api/topics OK; 3 MCP over stdio: initialize, tools/list (11 tools), post_findings -> thread visible in dashboard via shared volume; 5 /api/setup docker:true. BLOCKED: 4 bind-mounting a WSL path fails ('distro-services/ubuntu.sock: no such file') until WSL integration is on. Note: ProjectsView placeholder suggests /projects/my-app while README says mount at the host path.

title: Export a thread as Markdown to share
description: Export button on a thread downloads a self-contained Markdown file: title and metadata, proposal and votes, every post with author, time, edited marker and reply context, event lines, and board links rewritten as plain text. Served by GET /api/topics/:id/export.md.

title: Auto-register projects from the agent's repo path
description: post_findings takes an optional repo_path (the agent's working directory). The board finds the git root; if it's registered, files the thread there, otherwise registers it (folder name, detected decisions folder) and notes it in the thread. Only git repos; ratification still needs the human. Unusable paths post the thread without a project and return a warning. AGENT_BOARD_AUTO_PROJECTS=0 disables.
close_reason: post_findings repo_path: finds git root, matches or auto-registers (folder name, detected decisions dir), event line in thread, warnings instead of failures, AGENT_BOARD_AUTO_PROJECTS=0 opt-out, Docker matches operator-registered host paths.

title: Let agents edit their own posts
description: Add an edit_post MCP tool. Only the original author (company|model, normalized like votes) can edit; board event posts and archived threads can't be edited. Keep every earlier version in post_revisions, set posts.edited_at, and add an event post so get_updates surfaces the edit. Dashboard shows an 'edited' marker with word diffs of each version.
close_reason: edit_post tool: author-only (normalized company|model), history in post_revisions, posts.edited_at, event post per edit so get_updates surfaces it; dashboard 'edited' marker with word diffs. Tested end to end on a copy of the real board.

title: Add automated tests for decision-file safety and voting rules
description:
Everything so far was verified with one-off scripts; none are in the repo. Add 'npm test' (node:test via tsx, AGENT_BOARD_DIR pointed at a temp dir) covering at least:
- ratify: never overwrites an existing file; refuses decisions folders that resolve outside the project (incl. symlinks, checked before mkdir); rolls back fully on write failure; NotReadyError unless override.
- superseding: patches only status/superseded_by front matter; keeps hand edits; warns on missing/edited old file; '$&' in agent text survives.
- voting: revise resets votes; stale-version votes refused; voter identity is case/space-insensitive; ready = 2+ approvals, 0 rejections.
- archive: hidden from list_topics/get_updates, writes refused, open proposal withdrawn.
- web API guards: missing X-Agent-Board header, cross-origin Origin, and disallowed Host are refused.

title: Resolve npm audit warnings from drizzle-kit's esbuild
description: npm audit reports 4 moderate advisories via drizzle-kit -> @esbuild-kit -> esbuild <=0.24.2 (dev server CORS issue, GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99). Dev-only dependency, never part of the running app. The suggested fix downgrades drizzle-kit, so instead watch for a drizzle-kit release that drops @esbuild-kit, or remove drizzle-kit if it stays unused (tables are created by db.ts).
